name: Matthias
headline: Turn Magenta’s usage data into subscriptions that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells mobile tariffs, home internet, Magenta TV and Magenta Family offers to every visitor in the same way, whether they arrive as a home customer, a family or a business.

The signal you already own is what customers use, stream and top up: data volumes, Magenta TV viewing, roaming trips and the moment a family adds a line. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message the customer receives.

Cross-sell, upsell and anti churn campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. A prepaid customer about to leave this week gets the same Disney+ or Netflix offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Catch the leaver before the cancellation
cases.text: Churn signals per line from data usage, top-up gaps and roaming. The right offer, channel and moment for each prepaid and postpaid customer, not one retention mail per segment.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Next offer that fits each household
cases.text: Next best tariff, Magenta Family line or streaming add-on per customer, triggered by what they actually use. No more blanket upgrade mails to customers already on the right plan.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep every customer using the service weekly
cases.text: Personal TV, data and roaming nudges by email and SMS, so each customer gets a reason to use Magenta again this week.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
